title: FastAPI service with JWT authentication
description: Create a FastAPI application with JWT authentication, PostgreSQL integration, user registration, login, logout and unit tests.
highlights: clean-install verification caught an undeclared dependency

title: Extending an existing codebase
description: Add a third strategy, fixed window, that follows the existing interface and conventions, and a small command-line demo. Add tests for the new strategy. (Starts from the rate limiter the previous task produced.)

title: Rate limiter library from an empty repository
description: Write a rate limiter library in Python with two strategies, token bucket and sliding window, behind one clean interface. Time must be injectable so tests do not sleep. Include thorough unit tests.
highlights: a flaky concurrency test found and fixed in 2 debugging passes

title: A run that did not converge, stopped by its budget
description: The same FastAPI task, recorded earlier. The debugger was shown only the end of a 115 KB test log, which hid the real error; it used all three attempts, review sent the work back, and the 90-call budget ended the run. The work was still exported. This recording led to the failure digest the system uses now.
highlights: 3 debugging attempts, all verified as failing
the bug it exposed is fixed
